bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen HERE


A new multisensory consciousness is transforming humanity, and with it comes a pressing question: what kind of power are you really reaching for? In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the internal dynamics of power struggles – what they are, where they originate, and why the impulse to control others is as present in our most intimate relationships as it is in conflicts between nations.

Every power struggle, Gary explains, is rooted in the pursuit of external power – the drive to change, manage, or dominate what exists outside of us.

Whether we are clashing with a partner or a roommate, or reaching for a fresh start in a new city, the horizontal path keeps us moving sideways. In the Earth School, we often find that nothing truly changes because we haven’t changed the frightened parts of our personality that are driving the conflict.

The vertical path is different. It is the path of spiritual evolution. It invites us to turn inward – to practice Emotional Awareness – and in doing so, to begin aligning our personality with our Soul. This alignment allows us to access the kind of Authentic Power that Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr. brought to bear on the world – a power rooted in love, not in the control of others.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:43) — The Internal Dynamics of a Power Struggle: Gary defines the core of every power struggle – the pursuit of external power through the impulse to control – and reveals how it operates at every scale, from intimate partnerships to international conflict.
  • (01:26) — The Horizontal Path and its Limitations: Attempting to find relief by changing partners, circumstances, or cities defines the horizontal path. Without internal change, the same frightened parts of the personality follow us wherever we go in the Earth School.
  • (01:56) — The Vertical Path: Gary introduces the only path that creates real transformation – the vertical path of spiritual evolution – and connects it to the emergence of Authentic Power.
  • (02:14) — The Fragility of External Power: For millennia, our species has sought safety through external power – competition, hoarding, and exploitation. Gary explains why this foundation now threatens our survival and the evolution of our consciousness.
  • (02:54) — The Soul’s Intentions: Harmony, cooperation, sharing, and a reverence for Life are the Soul’s true intentions. Gary describes the creative tension humanity now inhabits as these values begin to emerge from the new consciousness.
  • (03:27) — Authentic Power in Action: As we align our personality with our Soul, we begin to cultivate the kind of power that moves mountains – the Authentic Power of Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr., anchored in a life lived from the frequency of love.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

This week, notice where power struggles show up in your life – in a disagreement with a partner, a moment of frustration with a colleague, or an urge to change something outside yourself to feel better inside. Pause before choosing the horizontal path. Ask yourself: Am I trying to control, or am I trying to grow? What would it look like to change myself here instead of the situation around me? Each time you choose the vertical path, you take one more step toward Authentic Power.
